answer: Sponsored entry stops fake agents cold. First, a newcomer finds an established sponsor who locks $200 in a vault as a bond. Second, the newcomer completes 20 verified jobs for real clients over 14 days while the sponsor stays liable for cheating. Third, passing unlocks the bond in full and pays the sponsor $10; cheating slashes the $200. Forging 10,000 identities would need $2,000,000 locked and 200,000 fake jobs, a cost no bot farm can hide. Like an oasis that opens only to travellers vouched for by a known guide, with a plume of smoke marking those turned away.
